steps: Stand upright with feet together, arms at your sides
Jump and spread your legs shoulder-width apart while raising arms overhead
Jump again to return to the starting position
Repeat at a steady, brisk pace
tips: Land softly on the balls of your feet
Keep your core tight throughout
Fully extend your arms overhead

steps: Start in a high plank — hands slightly wider than shoulders
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows
Push back up to the starting position
tips: Don't flare elbows out past 45°
Engage your core — no sagging hips
Drop to knees for an easier version

steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out
Push your hips back as if sitting into a chair
Lower until thighs are parallel to the floor (or as low as comfortable)
Drive through your heels to stand back up
tips: Keep your knees tracking over your toes
Chest up, back straight
Weight in your heels, not toes

steps: Stand tall, then squat down and place hands on the floor
Jump or step your feet back into a plank position
Do one push-up (optional for beginners)
Jump or step feet forward to your hands, then explode upward with arms overhead
tips: Land softly when jumping
Modify by stepping instead of jumping
Keep a strong plank — don't let hips sag

steps: Start face-down, then prop yourself on forearms and toes
Keep elbows directly under shoulders
Engage your core and hold your body in a straight line
Breathe steadily — don't hold your breath
tips: Squeeze your glutes to keep hips level
Look at the floor to keep your neck neutral
Don't let your lower back arch or sag

steps: Start in a high plank position with hands under shoulders
Drive your right knee toward your chest
Quickly switch legs, bringing left knee forward
Continue alternating at a fast pace, like running in place
tips: Keep hips level — don't bounce them up
Hands stay planted, don't shift forward
Go faster for more cardio, slower for more core

steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart
Step forward with one leg and lower your hips
Both knees should bend to about 90 degrees
Push through your front heel to return to standing, then switch legs
tips: Front knee shouldn't pass your toes
Keep your torso upright
Alternate legs each rep

steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart
Drive your right knee up toward your chest
Quickly switch to the left knee
Pump your arms and maintain a fast pace
tips: Aim to get knees to hip height
Stay on the balls of your feet
Keep your core engaged throughout

steps: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor
Place hands behind your head or across your chest
Curl your shoulders off the floor by engaging your abs
Lower back down with control — don't just drop
tips: Don't pull on your neck
Focus on curling your ribcage toward your pelvis
Exhale as you crunch up

steps: Lie on your back, hands behind head, legs lifted with knees bent 90°
Bring your right elbow toward your left knee while extending right leg
Switch sides — left elbow to right knee
Continue in a pedaling motion
tips: Rotate from your torso, not just your elbows
Keep lower back pressed to the floor
Move slowly and controlled for best results

steps: Lie flat on your back, legs extended, hands by your sides (or under hips)
Keeping legs straight, raise them toward the ceiling
Lift until your legs are perpendicular to the floor
Lower slowly back down without touching the floor
tips: Press your lower back into the floor
Move slowly — don't use momentum
Bend knees slightly to make it easier

steps: Sit on the floor with knees bent, feet slightly off the ground
Lean back slightly to engage your core, keep your back straight
Clasp your hands together (or hold a weight)
Rotate your torso to touch the floor on each side
tips: Keep your chest lifted
Rotate from your ribcage, not just arms
Lift feet for more challenge, plant them for easier

steps: Lie flat on your back, hands under your hips for support
Lift both legs a few inches off the ground
Kick one leg up while the other stays low
Alternate in a quick, fluttering motion
tips: Keep lower back pressed to the floor
Small controlled kicks — about 6 inches range
Don't hold your breath

steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart
Lower into a squat position
Explosively jump up, extending your body fully
Land softly back into the squat position
tips: Land softly with bent knees to absorb impact
Swing arms for momentum
Keep chest up throughout

steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent
Jump straight up as high as you can
At the top, tuck your knees toward your chest
Extend legs and land softly on the balls of your feet
tips: Focus on height, not speed
Land softly with bent knees
Use arm swing to generate power

steps: Stand on your right foot, left foot off the ground
Leap laterally to the left, landing on your left foot
Swing right foot behind left leg for balance
Immediately leap back to the right — continue alternating
tips: Stay low in an athletic stance
Swing your arms for balance and power
Land softly on the ball of your foot

steps: Stand facing forward with feet shoulder-width apart
Drop into a quarter-squat and swing arms back
Explode upward, jumping as high as possible
Land softly with bent knees, then step back and repeat
tips: Focus on soft landings with bent knees
Use your arms to help generate upward force
Stand fully upright at the top

steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart in a running stance
Begin running in place as fast as you can
Drive knees high and pump arms hard
Stay on the balls of your feet
tips: Lean slightly forward
Pump arms vigorously — they drive your speed
Breathe rhythmically

steps: Start in a plank position
Place hands close together under your chest, forming a diamond/triangle shape
Lower your chest toward your hands by bending elbows
Push back up to the starting position
tips: Keep elbows close to your body
Harder than regular push-ups — go to knees if needed
Focus on squeezing your triceps at the top

steps: Sit on the edge of a sturdy chair/bench, hands gripping the edge
Slide your hips off the edge, supporting yourself with your arms
Lower your body by bending elbows to about 90 degrees
Push back up to straighten your arms
tips: Keep your back close to the chair
Don't shrug your shoulders up
Extend legs further out for more challenge

steps: Start in a downward dog position — hips high, forming an inverted V
Place hands shoulder-width apart
Bend elbows and lower the top of your head toward the floor
Push back up to the starting pike position
tips: Keep hips high throughout the movement
Great shoulder press substitute with no equipment
Walk feet closer to hands for more difficulty

steps: Stand tall with arms extended straight out to the sides
Make small forward circles with both arms
Gradually increase the size of the circles
Reverse direction halfway through
tips: Keep your core engaged and stand tall
Don't shrug your shoulders
Start small and go bigger

steps: Start in a high plank position, hands under shoulders
Lift your right hand and tap your left shoulder
Place it back down, then tap right shoulder with left hand
Continue alternating while keeping hips as still as possible
tips: Widen your feet for more stability
Fight the urge to rotate your hips
Go slowly — this is about control

steps: Stand or sit tall with shoulders relaxed
Slowly drop your chin to your chest
Roll your head gently to the right, bringing ear toward shoulder
Continue the circle to the back, then left, and back to center
tips: Move very slowly and gently
Don't force any position that causes pain
Reverse direction after a few rolls

steps: Bring your right arm across your chest
Use your left hand to gently press above or below the elbow
Hold for 15 seconds, feeling the stretch in your shoulder
Switch arms and repeat
tips: Don't press on the elbow joint directly
Keep your shoulder down, not shrugged
Breathe deeply and relax into it

steps: Stand tall (hold a wall for balance if needed)
Bend your right knee and grab your right ankle behind you
Pull your heel gently toward your glute
Hold for 15 seconds, then switch legs
tips: Keep your knees close together
Stand tall — don't lean forward
Push your hips slightly forward for a deeper stretch

steps: Stand tall and extend one leg forward, heel on the ground, toes up
Hinge at the hips and lean your torso forward slightly
Place hands on your thigh for support
Hold for 15 seconds, then switch legs
tips: Keep your back straight — hinge from the hips
Don't bounce — hold steady
You should feel the stretch behind your thigh

steps: Kneel on the floor, sit back on your heels
Fold forward, extending arms out in front of you
Rest your forehead on the floor
Breathe deeply and relax into the stretch
tips: Spread your knees wider for more comfort
Walk hands forward for a deeper shoulder stretch
This is a resting pose — fully relax

steps: Start on hands and knees (tabletop position)
COW: Inhale, drop your belly, lift your chest and tailbone up
CAT: Exhale, round your back, tuck chin and tailbone under
Flow between the two positions with your breath
tips: Move slowly with your breath
Great for warming up or cooling down the spine
Initiate the movement from your pelvis

steps: From hands and knees, bring right knee forward behind right wrist
Extend your left leg straight back behind you
Square your hips toward the floor as much as possible
Fold forward over your front shin for a deeper stretch
tips: Use a pillow under your hip if it doesn't reach the floor
Keep your back leg straight
Hold for at least 30 seconds per side
